check(API.echo_nat_box(box).value == box.value)
check(API.echo_again(API::NatBoxAgain.new(value: 4, count: 1)).value == 4)
check(API.echo_text_box(API::TextBox.new(value: greeting, count: 0)).value == greeting)
left = API.echo_left(API::LeftBox.new(value: 5, count: 2))
right = API.echo_right(API::RightBox.new(value: 6, count: 3))
check(left.instance_of?(API::LeftBox) && left.value == 5)
check(right.instance_of?(API::RightBox) && right.count == 3)
check(API::LeftBox != API::RightBox && API::LeftBox != API::NatBox)
specialized_boxes = API.echo_boxes(boxes)
check(specialized_boxes.length == 3 && specialized_boxes[2].value == 2**70 && API.echo_boxes([]).empty?)
specialized_optional = API.echo_optional_boxes(API::Some.new(boxes))
check(specialized_optional.instance_of?(API::Some) && specialized_optional.value[2].value == 2**70)
check(API.echo_optional_boxes(nil).nil? && API.echo_optional_boxes(API::Some.new([])).value.empty?)
check(API.echo_nats([0, 2**70]) == [0, 2**70] && API.echo_nats([]).empty?)
check(API.echo_optional_nat(API::Some.new(2**70)).value == 2**70 && API.echo_optional_nat(nil).nil?)
check(rejected { API.echo_left(API::RightBox.new(value: 5, count: 2)) })
check(rejected { API.echo_boxes([API::NatBoxAgain.new(value: 1, count: 0)]) })
check(rejected { API.echo_optional_nat(API::Some.new(-1)) })
check(API.echo_left(API::LeftBox.new(value: 7, count: 0)).value == 7)
